## UC Berkeley

Graduate student instructor, 2016–2021: Intermediate Microeconomics seven
times and Psychology and Economics once, plus one semester as head GSI. In
Spring 2019 I taught the Intermediate Microeconomics lecture to about 400
students.
[Outstanding GSI Award](https://gsi.berkeley.edu/programs-services/award-programs/ogsi/), 2018.

# Advising

I am always happy to talk about research ideas related to my work, whether you
are a TSE student, a student elsewhere, a researcher, or a practitioner. If
you are curious to talk, just send me an
[email](mailto:maximilian.muller@tse-fr.eu).

At TSE I run the BID Workshop for PhD students (since 2023) and co-advise
[Lony Bessagnet](https://sites.google.com/view/lonybessagnet/home).
